senses.gloss: c. (טְמַר, v. טְמוֹר) hidden, secret; (also as noun) secrecy.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on I Samuel 10:22">Targ. I Sam. X, 22</cite>.
Ib. XXI, 3 (h. text אלמני); a. fr.—עבד ט׳ to live hidden.

V, 48ᵈ</cite> top <cite ref="I00553"><he>טמירא</he></cite>.—Pl. <he>טְמִירִין</he>, f. <cite ref="I00553"><he>טְמִירָן</he></cite>, <he>טְמִירָתָא</he>.
